Name: DE-Clients
Statement:
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.CommercialClient)
select  cli.Oid as DocumentOid,
        cli.Oid as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        cli.ExternalId,
        cli.Code as Code,
        cli.Email,
        cli.Phone,
        cli.HeadOffice,
        cli.Street,
        cli.Street2,
        cli.City as Location,
        cli.CreatedOnUtc as CreatedOn,
        cli.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn,
        cli.AllowsTimesheet,
        clg.Oid as ClientGroupId,
        clg.Name as ClientGroup,
        cli.TaxPayerNumber,
        cli.Margin as Margin,
        cli.FullTimeEmployeeTime,
        cli.SupplierMargin,
        wfs.Oid as StageId,
        wfs.Name as Stage,
        wst.Oid as StageTypeId,
        wst.Name as StageType,
        mng.Id as ManagerId,
        mng.Name as ManagerName,
        mng.HasImage as ManagerHasImage,
        own.Id as OwnerId,
        own.Name as OwnerName,
        own.HasImage as OwnerHasImage
from    CommercialClient cli
            left join ClientGroup clg on clg.Oid = cli.ClientGroup
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = cli.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
            left Join UserLookup mng on mng.Id = cli.ProjectManager
            left Join UserLookup own on own.Id = cli.ProjectOwner
where   wst.Status != 1
